verdict.rationale: Hatchet is open-source and self-hostable, meaning users control their own Postgres-backed control plane and inherently retain access to underlying data (hatchet-docs-8, hatchet-docs-17, hatchet-docs-23), which supports an exit path. However, there is no explicit documented data-export feature, open-format export tooling, or migration/export API mentioned anywhere in the evidence. Missing for 10: explicit data export command/API, documentation on open-format export (e.g. JSON/CSV dumps), and independent confirmation that a full data export is possible beyond raw DB access.
